description: This file defines the DateValue class, which provides a wizard interface for creating and managing conditional formatting rules based on date/time periods in PhpSpreadsheet. It includes methods for common date ranges like today, yesterday, this week, last month, etc.

classes.name: DateValue
classes.description: Class for configuring date-based conditional formatting rules using wizard methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DateValue wizard with a cell range.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Sets the operator/string value associated with a specific date condition.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Builds the formula expression for the conditional formatting based on the operator.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Returns a Conditional object representing the current date condition rule.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a DateValue wizard instance from an existing Conditional for modification or inspection.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to handle calls to date-range methods like today(), lastWeek(), etc., mapping them to internal operators.
